title.en: Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?
Kon'yakusha ga Uwaki Aite to Kakeochi shimashita. Ouji Denka ni Dekiaisarete Shiawase na no de, Imasara Modoritai to Iwarete mo Komarimasu.
Reiketsu Ryuuou Heika no "Unmei no Tsugai" rashii Desu ga, Koukyuu ni Hikikomorou to Omoimasu
Nariyuki de Kon'yaku o Moushikonda Yowaki Binbou Reijou desu ga, Nazeka Jiki Koushaku-sama ni Dekiai sarete Torawarete imasu @Comic
Suterare Hanayome no Saikon - Koori no Henkyou Haku wa Saiai o Chikau
Mujikaku Seijo wa Kyou mo Muishiki ni Chikara wo Tarenagasu
Gijou ga Akuyaku Reijou to shite Hametsu suru Koto wo Shitta no de, Mechakucha Aishimasu - Keiyaku Kekkon de Watashi ni Kanshin ga Nakatta Hazu no Koushaku-sama ni, Kizuitara Dekiaisaretemashita
Munou Saijo wa Akujo ni Naritai ~Gimai no Migawari de Totsuida Reijou, Koushaku-sama no Dekiai ni Kizukanai~
Iekara Nigedashitai Watashi ga, Ukkari Akogare no Daimahoutsukai-sama wo Katteshimattara
"Shinde Miro" to Iwareta no de Shinimashita.
Hakyoku Yotei no Akujo no Hazu ga, Reitetsu Koushaku-sama ga Wakaretekuremasen!
Kawaii Gimai ga Konyakuhaki Saretarashii no de, Ima kara "Orei" ni Mairimasu
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
